text:
maya: Heads up — noticed a quality regression on canary for qwen-40b longcontext after yesterday's kernel selector + prefetch change. Short examples now drop repeated entity tokens, eval fail rate +4.8% on our regression suite :grimacing:

zach: uh ok — which change? commit or config?

maya: commit 1a2b3f4 (kernel-priority) + config 'enable_prefetch=true' on dedicated pools. Repro: inputs with repeated named entities get truncated, not continuing the mention.

rachel: pasted profiler summary from perf-bot — KV cache miss spikes during warmup, batching bumped 4->8. P99 latency +12ms, token throughput +7% but eval accuracy down. suspect mismatch between tiled-attn kernel and our KV layout assumptions.

liam: can you drop a tiny repro snippet? also we should bisect kernel-selector vs prefetch vs batch-size.

maya: minimal repro run I used:

```
python serve_local.py --model qwen-40b --batch_size 8 --kernel-selector=auto --enable_prefetch
```

Input: "Alice visited Paris. Alice then..."
Observed: "Alice visited Paris." (stops repeating/continuing),

perf-bot: trace summary -> route=qwen-40b/canary kernel=tile_attn_v2 kv_eviction_rate=0.18 cache_miss_warmup=0.32 eval_regression=+4.8% (n=1200 prompts)

zach: interesting — when auto picked tile_attn_v2 (seq>1024) our kv-layout isn't contiguous the same way as legacy_attn. Could be ROPe offset normalization or prefetch timing.

rachel: quick local bisect: enable_prefetch=false on the same canary build drops regression back to baseline. So prefetch looks causal. Also forcing kernel=legacy_attn removes the regression even with prefetch=true.

liam: OK options: (1) rollback prefetch on canary, (2) force kernel fallback for qwen-40b until we patch, (3) fix prefetch to align KV layout. Ops, can we rollback config quickly?

ops-deploy: can rollback to previous config snapshot for canary in ~5m. need signoff from eng-runtime.

maya: +1 to rollback prefetch on canary now. I'll open an issue to track kernel+prefetch integration and add a unit asserting KV layout parity between kernels.

zach: created issue RFC-428 'prefetch-kernel-kv-alignment' and assigned to eng-runtime. Also adding an eval gate on canary to fail-fast if accuracy drops >1%.

rachel: uploaded profiler artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/qwen/canary/2049876543/trace.json

maya: thanks — rolling back prefetch on canary, scheduling a short postmortem Wed. tagging folks; please react if you want to join :calendar: :eyes:

(reactions: maya :thumbsup:, rachel :rocket:)
